overall: The AG found the North Adams City Council violated the Open Meeting Law when a councilor emailed a quorum of members with a developer's views plus his own remarks on a pending tax issue. No further relief was ordered because the Council read the email aloud at its next meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a councilor emailed all council members a third party's views on a pending tax classification issue, adding his own commentary, which was deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we conclude that the email constituted impermissible deliberation outside of a posted meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25).
remedy_passage: We order the Council's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Council that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
